$comment: STATIC COPY, not placeholder records — the backend has no definitions table, so the text behind every ⓘ on #/overview lives here. What a figure means, how it is computed, what it includes and which clock it runs on. The Overview stores NOTHING of its own: every number is derived from backend reads in src/admin/views/Overview/ — store.ts (deals, roster), live.ts (snapshot money, team table, attention), financeLive.ts (the Finance section) — plus two server-counted reads, GET admin/overview/operations/ and GET admin/overview/signals/. When a definition here stops matching that code, the ⓘ is lying: change the text in the same edit as the code.

collected.label: Collected
collected.what: Money that actually arrived in the period — deal payments, plan purchases and other income.
collected.how: Σ deal-ledger payments by payment date (a reversed payment counts for nothing) + Σ plan purchases marked Paid or Refunded, at their full amount, by verified date (₹0 free plans are not payments) + Σ recorded other income by value date. A refund is not taken off here: it is money out on the day it is settled, under Out. The one exception is a plan payment refunded before refund requests existed (Refunded, with no settled request), which still nets its refund off.
collected.includes: Finance → Subscriptions (deal ledger), plan payments and Other Transaction income. Deal payments only on deals this session can see. Never deal values. "N payments" counts deal and plan payments, not income.
collected.period: The selected period, live (today in IST). Compared with the same number of days immediately before it.

pipeline.label: Pipeline value
pipeline.what: The value of the deals opened in the period that are still open now.
pipeline.how: Σ deal value over deals created inside the period whose current stage is not a final one (the server marks Won and Lost final). A deal with no value yet is counted in the number of deals, shown as "without a value", and adds nothing to the value.
pipeline.includes: Deals this session can see: its own and co-owned deals, or every deal with full access, narrowed by the owner filter. Read from one list of up to 500 deals.
pipeline.period: Created in the selected period, open as of now. Live (today in IST). Not compared.

won.label: Won
won.what: Deals that reached Won in the period, and what they were worth.
won.how: Count and Σ value of deals whose current stage is Won and whose stage-since date falls in the period. The arrow compares the count with the previous period.
won.includes: Only deals still at Won today. A won deal later moved back is not counted.
won.period: The selected period, live (today in IST). Compared with the same number of days immediately before it.

conversion.label: Conversion
conversion.what: Of the deals that closed in the period, the share that closed as Won.
conversion.how: Won ÷ (Won + Lost) × 100, to one decimal, both counted by the date they reached that stage. Shows — when nothing closed. The arrow is the change in points.
conversion.includes: Closed deals only. Open deals do not lower the rate.
conversion.period: The selected period, live (today in IST). Compared with the same number of days immediately before it.

outstanding.label: Receivable
outstanding.what: Installment money that falls due in the period and has not arrived.
outstanding.how: Σ installments with status due or failed whose due date is inside the period. The line under it splits them into due and failed.
outstanding.includes: Installments of accepted quotations on deals this session can see. Deal values with no accepted quotation behind them are not receivable yet.
outstanding.period: Due dates inside the selected period, live (today in IST). Not compared.

team.label: Today
team.what: Who has opened their day, who has not, and who is away.
team.how: Counted by the server. Present: opened a day today, whatever state it is in now. Late: present and marked late. Absent: no day, not on approved leave, and past their auto-close time (never on a Sunday). On leave: no day, and approved leave covers today. Day never closed: a day still open past its auto-close time.
team.includes: The team roster — active admin accounts, superusers left out — narrowed to one role when the Department filter is set.

overdue.label: Tasks
overdue.what: Open work that is late, blocked, due soon or moving — and what got finished.
overdue.how: Counted by the server. Overdue: not completed or cancelled, due date before today. Waiting on another: open, and the item it waits on is still open. Due in 7 days: open, due today through today + 7. In progress: in progress and not overdue. Completed: completed on a date inside the period.
overdue.includes: Work items assigned to the team roster — active admin accounts, superusers left out — narrowed to one role when the Department filter is set.
overdue.period: Right now, today in IST; Completed uses the selected period.

enquiries.label: Enquiries
enquiries.what: New business enquiries received in the last seven days, and today.
enquiries.how: Counted by the server: everything received in the 7 × 24 hours before now, and everything received since midnight today. No filter set in the Enquiries queue applies.
enquiries.includes: Every enquiry in the queue, whatever its source or status. Live.
enquiries.period: The last 7 days, always, on the server's IST clock. This tile ignores the period picker.

health.label: Health
health.what: Four one-line reads on the parts of the business that fail quietly.
health.how: Pipeline: share of the deals created in the period and still open that are flagged stalled (under 15% ok, under 35% watch, else a problem). Collections: any failed installment is a problem, any installment still due past its due date is a watch. Team: attendance days in the period that were opened and not left unclosed — the share not marked late (85% ok, 65% watch). Delivery: overdue work items as a share of every open one (under 10% ok, under 30% watch).
health.includes: One read per area in this session's access. It is not a score and is not averaged. Team and Delivery follow the Department filter.
health.period: Pipeline and Team use the selected period; Collections and Delivery are as of now. All live, today in IST.

dealflow.label: Deal flow
dealflow.what: How many deals were created, won and lost in each slice of the period.
dealflow.how: Created by created date. Won and Lost by the date the deal reached that stage, for deals still at it. Grouped by day up to 14 days, by week up to 120, by month beyond.
dealflow.includes: Every deal the session can see. Lost is counted so a quiet chart is not mistaken for a good one.
dealflow.period: The selected period, live (today in IST).

moneyflow.label: Money in and out
moneyflow.what: What arrived and what left in each slice of the period.
moneyflow.how: In = deal payments + plan purchases + other income, the Collected rule. Out = salary runs on the day they were paid + recorded spend that is not tax-excluded + refunds on the day they were settled. Each slice runs the same arithmetic as the Net tile over its own dates.
moneyflow.includes: Backend finance records. Tax-excluded spend leaves the bank but is kept out of Out, as it is in Finance.
moneyflow.period: The selected period, live (today in IST).

funnel.label: Pipeline by stage
funnel.what: Where the deals sit right now, and what each stage is worth.
funnel.how: Count and Σ value of deals currently at each stage, in the server's stage order. Won is every deal at Won today, not only this period's. The stalled link counts open deals flagged stalled.
funnel.includes: Every deal the session can see. Lost is left off — it is the exit, not a stage.

byowner.label: By owner
byowner.what: Who is carrying the open pipeline.
byowner.how: Deals grouped by owner: open count, Σ open value, and how many reached Won in the period. Ranked by open value.
byowner.includes: Owner only — a co-owner is not credited here. Unowned deals are in no row.
byowner.period: Open now; won in the selected period.

lens.label: Deals that need a look
lens.what: Four ways to rank the open pipeline.
lens.how: At risk: stalled, else next action overdue, else expected close in the past — one reason each, biggest value first, then most days late. Closing soon: expected close today through today + 14. Highest value: by value, unvalued last. Longest in stage: oldest stage date first.
lens.includes: Open deals only — any stage the server does not mark final.

teamtable.label: Team performance
teamtable.what: One row per member: their deals, what their deals have collected, their tasks and their attendance.
teamtable.how: Deals: open deals they own, plus how many they won in the period. Collected: Σ money collected on deals they own, all time. Tasks: completed in the period (by completion date) / open now / overdue now. On time: days they opened in the period and did not leave unclosed, the share not marked late. Ranked by collected, then completed, then fewest overdue.
teamtable.includes: Active accounts on the team roster, narrowed to one role by the Department filter; the subtitle is the roles they hold. Deals and money come from the Deals API, joined on the owner.
teamtable.period: Tasks completed and attendance use the selected period; deals and open work are as of now. Live, today in IST.

load.label: Load
load.what: How much open work a member is carrying, against the busiest person on the team.
load.how: Open items ÷ the highest open count in the table. Red when three or more of theirs are overdue, amber when any is.
load.includes: Work items assigned to them that are not completed or cancelled.

net.label: Net
net.what: Cash movement for the period: what came in minus what went out.
net.how: Deal payments + plan purchases + other income − salary runs paid − recorded spend that is not tax-excluded − refunds settled. Each is counted on the date the money moved. Cash, not profit.
net.includes: Backend finance records — the same rules as Collected and as the Net cash trajectory signal.
net.period: The selected period, live (today in IST). Compared with the same number of days immediately before it.

duesoon.label: Due in 30 days
duesoon.what: Installments that fall due in the next thirty days.
duesoon.how: Σ amount of installments with status due and a due date from today through today + 30.
duesoon.includes: Installments of accepted quotations on deals this session can see.
duesoon.period: Forward from today, IST. Ignores the period picker.

payroll.label: Payroll owed
payroll.what: Salary that has been run and not paid.
payroll.how: The open salary run: Σ net of its slips with no paid date, and how many people those slips are for.
payroll.includes: Only shown to a session holding Salaries A/C access.

ops.label: Operations
ops.what: Where execution is blocked on a person.
ops.how: One server read, counts only. Tasks and Today as their own ⓘ say. Owed to a manager: no plan today and end-of-day report owed (only members with a manager; the report only after their auto-close), today's submitted reports nobody acknowledged, leave requests waiting for a decision, agreements sent and never opened, members short of a required document.
ops.includes: The team roster — active admin accounts, superusers left out — narrowed to one role by the Department filter. Leave to decide is the whole queue, filter or not.
ops.period: Today in IST; tasks completed use the selected period.

attention.label: Needs attention
attention.what: Everything on this page that is a problem, in one ranked list.
attention.how: Rules, not opinions: a stalled deal, an overdue next action or a passed close date (urgent when the deal is in the top quarter of the open pipeline by value); conversion down 15 points or more; a failed installment; an installment past due; a refund approved and not sent; refund requests to decide; an unexplained bank line; collections down 20% or more; an open payroll run; an urgent or high-priority overdue task; a member with three or more overdue items; a plan or end-of-day report owed; reports not read; a day never closed; leave waiting; an agreement expiring within 7 days. Ranked by severity, then by money or days at stake.
attention.includes: Only areas in the session's access. Nothing is listed until every source has answered.
attention.period: Live, today in IST. Deal and collection comparisons use the selected period against the one before it.

signals.label: Planning signals
signals.what: What the next few weeks look like from today's records.
signals.how: Expected to close: open deals whose expected close date is in this calendar month. Largest open deals: the three biggest by value. Net cash trajectory: net cash for the last three calendar months, this one included, counted by the server on the Net rules — rising or falling is the first month against the last. Next 30 days: installments due in the next 30 days plus every unpaid, un-held payslip. Due in the next 7 days: open work due today through today + 7, by member. Away: approved leave overlapping the next 14 days.
signals.includes: Forecasts from dated records only; nothing is projected. Payroll needs Salaries A/C; away needs full access.

clock.label: Clocks
clock.what: Which date every section on this page runs on.
clock.how: Every section reads the backend live, on one clock: today in IST. Period windows count back from today's date; figures the server counts (Operations, Planning signals, Enquiries) use the server's own IST date. A custom range is absolute and applies to every section as written.
clock.includes: Each section stamps its clock beside its title.
